inputs.text: They’re trying to make Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe the whole story: the Technical Evaluation Committee chair, singled out over Ksh.283 million spent on land deemed unsuitable for a cemetery. The court may have found she played a central role, but that doesn’t explain who else enabled the purchase—or why the spotlight stops with her. Recovering money from one committee member could be a tidy way to protect the wider machinery and the people who benefited from it. The real question is who gets shielded when blame is kept this narrow.
